propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the twelve-month debit card roadmap and refreshed its business case each quarter with finance.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the roadmap work and the former director confirmed it in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate presented the contactless-limit change and the virtual-card proposal to the product committee, which approved both.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the presentations and the reference confirms the virtual-card proposal.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has held a head-of-product role with line management of product managers.
propositions.rationale: The head-of-product wording appears only as an acting title on the cover of a strategy paper the candidate wrote; it gives no dates, appointment or reports, the employer-checked title is Product Manager, Cards, and the qualification rule forbids inferring seniority or role level from a job title.

expectedGap: No employment record shows a group product manager or head-of-product appointment or any line management of product managers; the acting title appears only on a self-authored document.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the employer-checked Product Manager title and the documented roadmap, scheme-change, committee and metrics work; do not describe the candidate as having held a head-of-product role or managed product managers.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate held a formal acting head-of-product assignment, its start and end dates, and how many product managers reported to them.
